slides.title: "Make my resume better" is the worst prompt you can type
Tailor it to one job
slides.prompt: Here is a job post: [paste]. Here is my resume: [paste]. List the 5 skills the post asks for most, then rewrite my top 3 bullets to show those skills. Use only what is true in my resume.
slides.tip: a resume aimed at one job beats a general one.

slides.title: Turn a duty into a result
slides.prompt: Rewrite this bullet so it shows what changed because of my work: [paste bullet]. Ask me 3 questions about numbers, time saved, or people helped, then write 2 versions using my answers.
slides.tip: it asks you for the facts instead of inventing them.

slides.title: Check it like a recruiter
slides.prompt: Act as a recruiter hiring for [job title]. Read my resume: [paste]. Tell me what you notice in the first 10 seconds, what is missing, and what makes you hesitate.
slides.tip: you see what a stranger sees.

caption:
"Make my resume better" gives you a generic resume. Ask for something specific instead. 👇

1️⃣ Tailor it to one job
2️⃣ Turn a duty into a result
3️⃣ Check it like a recruiter
